mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5%, the compression of discount rates on equity cash flows drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, the compression of discount rates reverses and equity valuations contract, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 230, the market anticipates a rate hike to combat inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, high housing starts (HOUST > 900) signal an overheating economy, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5%, recessionary conditions compress corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95, the economy is in a contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 900 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) exceeds 400,000, the strong demand for housing signals a robust economy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 AND RSAFS > 400000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.
